---
title: 'funga_distribution_gap'
description: 'Find candidate new Brazilian state records for a fungal taxon'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::funga_distribution_gap()
```

### Description

Given a fungal genus or species, checks [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org),
[speciesLink](https://specieslink.net), and (optionally) the
[Reflora Virtual Herbarium](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/reflora/) for specimen/occurrence
evidence of the taxon in Brazilian states that are *not* currently listed in its
official Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB) distribution. This flags candidate new state
records for a taxonomist to manually verify - e.g. a species listed by FFB only for
Bahia, but with specimens indexed from Pernambuco.

### Details

FFB's own officially-listed states are retrieved the same way `funga_records`
does internally, from the parsed FFB distribution table. Occurrence evidence beyond FFB
comes from up to three independent sources (see `sources`): GBIF's public REST API
(no key required, and the most reliable of the three), speciesLink's public web service
(best-effort - see `funga_mycobank_gap`'s Note on its known SSL/endpoint
issues), and the refloraR package's `reflora_records` for
REFLORA specimen data (used only if the refloraR package is installed).

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character. A single fungal genus or species name (e.g. `"Trichoderma harzianum"` or `"Trichoderma"`). |
| state | Character vector. Optional subset of Brazilian states (full name or acronym) to restrict the check to. `NULL` (default) checks all states with any evidence from the requested `sources`. |
| sources | Character vector. Which occurrence sources to query: any of `"gbif"`, `"speciesLink"`, `"reflora"`. Defaults to all three. |
| version | Character. FFB dataset version to compare against. Defaults to `"latest"`. Passed to `funga_records`. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the result is saved to disk as an `.xlsx` spreadsheet. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the spreadsheet is saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"funga_distribution_gap"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the `.xlsx` file (without extension) to save. Defaults to `"funga_distribution_gap_<taxon>"`. |
| html_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), also writes a self-contained HTML report (`<dir>/<filename>.html`) summarizing the results: KPI counts, an evidence-by-source breakdown, the full state-by-state table, and the individual occurrence records (not aggregated) found in the new-state-record candidate states - each linking out to the specific record in its source database (GBIF occurrence page or REFLORA specimen page) - all as sortable, filterable DT widgets with buttons to copy or download them as CSV/Excel. Requires the rmarkdown, DT, and htmltools packages; if any is missing, the report is skipped with a message (the `.xlsx` spreadsheet is unaffected). |
| open_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default in interactive sessions), opens the rendered HTML report in the default browser. |

### Value

A `data.frame`, one row per Brazilian state with any occurrence evidence
  for `taxon`, with columns:

  TaxonThe queried taxon name.
  StateBrazilian state name.
  In_FFB_distributionLogical; whether FFB already lists this state for the taxon.
  GBIF_recordsNumber of Brazil GBIF occurrence records in this state (when
    `"gbif" %in% sources`).
  speciesLink_evidenceLogical; whether speciesLink reported this state
    (best-effort, see Details).
  REFLORA_recordsNumber of REFLORA specimen records in this state (when
    `"reflora" %in% sources` and refloraR is installed).
  New_state_record_candidate`TRUE` when the state has evidence from at
    least one external source but is *not* in `In_FFB_distribution` - i.e. a
    candidate worth manual taxonomic review.

### Examples

```r
gap <- funga_distribution_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma harzianum")

# Restrict the check to two states, using only GBIF
gap_ba_pe <- funga_distribution_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma harzianum",
                                    state = c("Bahia", "Pernambuco"),
                                    sources = "gbif")
```
